firstLift.note: Facebook, 10 November 2025: "OPENING AT 3PM!!! ... the start of the 25/26 Trollhaugen Season is finally here". Preseason hours 3-8pm, Nissebakken and Tomtebakken park on Chair 3 plus rope; no rentals, no lessons, no beginner terrain.

fullOps.note: Facebook, 22 November 2025: "NORMAL HOURS BEGIN 11/28". Rentals, ski shop, snack bar and lounge from 11/28; Chair 2 and Storebakken/Minibakken added for Thanksgiving weekend. Closed 11/24-11/27 to make snow. Lessons lagged to 12/1.

firstLift.note: Facebook, 19 November 2021, "OPENING WEEKEND" with the full schedule: "FRIDAY NOV.19TH 2pm-8pm | $30 Lift Tickets | 1 Chair + 1 Rope | Nissebakken & Tomte Park | Snack Bar Open | Bar Closed | Ski Shop 12-6pm". The next day’s post opens "Day 2 let’s go!!", confirming Friday was day one. Pre-season by the hill’s own description on 17 Nov: "limited terrain, no rentals or lessons, and reduced Snack Bar & Skol hours". Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays were closed for the following fortnight.

Facebook, 19 October 2022, same day: "WHO WANTS FIRST CHAIR — We will be OPEN TODAY for some preseason playtime", and a second post that day naming the riders who "earned the coveted first chair at Troll + first chair in North America badge for the 22/23 season". Two days of preseason only: open again 20 Oct 2-8pm, then "closing down our preseason playtime at 7pm" on the 21st, shut until 14 November. Wild Mountain opened at noon on 18 October 2022, a day earlier, and both claims hold: Wild opened a rope tow, Troll opened a chairlift. Troll’s claim is specifically the first chairlift spinning in North America, not the first hill open.

fullOps.note: Facebook, 28 November 2022: "We’re back to normal operating hours for daily Troll fun", with the normal rope hours listed. Before this the week was patchy — closed Thanksgiving, 3-9pm weekdays. The same calendar date as the hill’s "NORMAL HOURS BEGIN 11/28" in 2025-26.

firstLift.note: Facebook, 2 November 2023, same day: "OPENING TODAY — Get the first turns of the 23/24 season today 11/2 from 3-9pm". The next day: "Thanks for enjoying Day 1 on the slopes with us". A false start — the hill shut on the 6th and posted on the 8th "Mother Nature wins this round. We will remain closed until snowmaking weather returns", not reopening until 22 November.

fullOps.note: Facebook, 30 November 2023: "It’s our last late 3pm start of preseason, and then we kick off normal season hours starting tomorrow. We have 8 Trails for you to enjoy". Terrain had been added through the preceding week: Vesterdahl on the 28th, Jim’s Run and Galende on the 29th, Valhalla Park on the 30th.

firstLift.note: Facebook, 27 November 2024, same day: "So much SNOW! The 24/25 Season starts TODAY Wednesday 11/27 from 12-8pm". The next day: "Day 1 of our 75th Anniversary Season was unbelievable". Four runs open by the 29th.

fullOps.note: Facebook, 8 December 2024: "Regular Hours are back and we’re open daily at 10am for skiing & snowboarding! Wahoo!" Eleven runs and six-plus lifts that weekend. Terrain kept filling in afterwards — Valhalla on the 12th, Bjorkedahl on the 18th, Chair 1 not until the 23rd — which is why the hill running normally comes before the hill being complete.

firstLift.note: Facebook, 1 December 2023, same day: "Buck Hill is NOW OPEN for the 2023-2024 season!" Confirms the announcement on buckhill.com/opening-friday-dec-1st.

fullOps.note: Opened at full operations. buckhill.com/opening-friday-dec-1st lists 13 of 16 trails, both terrain parks, and the new Center Chair plus North Chair, Red Tail rope tow and both carpets, from day one.

firstLift.note: Reported by the author from Buck Hill’s Facebook feed, 25 August 2026. Archive agrees it was shut on 2 November ("OPENING FOR WINTER 2024-2025 AS WEATHER ALLOWS", all days Closed).

fullOps.note: Reported by the author from Buck Hill’s Facebook feed, 25 August 2026. Note a later blog post dated 23 December 2024 titled "BUCK HILL IS 100% OPEN!", which may mark the last trails rather than full operations — unresolved.

firstLift.note: Confirmed on the day by Facebook, 22 November 2022: "Come enjoy opening day with us! The skiing and snowboarding will be perfect with a sunny sky, 30 degree temp, and silky smooth corduroy" and "First day vibes are the best vibes!". Announced 16 Nov, trailed by "opens tomorrow" on the 21st and "the best part of opening weekend" on the 27th.

Confirmed on the day by Facebook, 29 November 2025: "Day one is on! Buck Hill is NOW OPEN FOR THE SEASON!", "Opening TODAY at 10:00 AM", and a post naming Max, Eli and Bob as the season’s First Chair. Preceded by "Buck Hill opens TOMORROW!" on the 28th.

fullOps.note: Facebook, 2 and 4 December 2025: "We are officially back on Friday, December 5th at 3:00 PM. New trails, more parks, and additional lifts will be ready to go." Snow tubing opened the same day and lessons were bookable. The hill ran the opening weekend of 29-30 November then closed 1-4 December to make snow, so this is the day it started operating as a hill rather than an event. Not 100%: more terrain followed on the 12th and the halfpipe on the 17th, both treated as bonus.

firstLift.note: Confirmed on the day by Facebook, 26 November 2021: "At 10:00 AM today Buck Hill will be officially open for the 2021-2022 season!", "WELCOME TO WINTER!", and that evening "Thanks to everyone for coming out to ski and snowboard today! There were smiles from top to bottom all day!" Announced 22 Nov ("On Friday, November 26th Buck Hill will be welcoming you back to winter") and 24 Nov. The Wayback archive holds no capture of this hill for the whole of Oct-Dec 2021.
Coffee Mill Ski Area Facebook, Saturday 18 December 2021.

cmskiarea.com WP post 9 Dec 2022, "22/23 SEASON OPENING DAY! 12/10/22": "open Saturday Dec 10th and Sunday Dec 11th, 10am-4pm. Singing Hill open with 2 lines of terrain park features. Only running the handle tow." Announced one day ahead; posts on 15 Dec about weekend hours and a weather closure confirm the season had started, and no correction was posted.

cmskiarea.com WP posts 12-13 Jan 2024: "BE CLOSED Saturday Jan 13th... Going to Try to be Open Sunday and Monday Jan 14th and 15th with limited operating hours and runs." A remarkably late start after "still currently closed" (9 Dec) and "Waiting for Cold" (28 Dec). This hill posts its changes, including the 13 Jan cancellation, and no further slip was posted; 18 Jan and 1 Feb posts confirm operation.

cmskiarea.com WP post 2 Dec 2024: "WE ARE OPENING!!! SATURDAY AND SUNDAY, DECEMBER 7th-8th, 11am-7pm." Announced five days ahead; the 9 Dec post giving 13-15 Dec hours confirms operation continued and no correction was posted.

cmskiarea.com WP post 3 Dec 2025: "OPEN THIS WEEKEND DECEMBER 13th and 14th, 10am-5pm... both lifts running which equals more runs." Announced ten days ahead; 15 Dec holiday-hours and 28 Dec open posts confirm operation, no correction posted.

FOX 9, 18 October 2022: "The ski area will open at noon on Tuesday, Oct. 18, after the snowmaking team hustled the previous two nights", and "the first ski area to open in North America, according to a news release". The same piece notes it ties the second-earliest opening in the hill’s history, alongside 18 October 1992, behind 7 October 2012. Archive agrees, with captures showing OPEN on 18-21 October and no capture earlier in the month.

aftonalps.com homepage banner, captured 25 and 28 November 2021, after the fact: "Opening Day Wed, Nov 24th at 3:30pm." The same banner had read "Afton Alps plans to open for winter November 19" from 5 October through 8 November, so the plan slipped five days. By 9 December: "Open for the 2021/22 Winter Season!"

aftonalps.com banner, 16 November 2022: "JOIN US FOR OPENING DAY, NOV 18"; by the 28th: "WE ARE OPEN FOR THE 2022-23 SEASON!" CBS Minnesota on 12 November reported snowmaking ahead of a "targeted opener next Friday", which is the 18th. Announced rather than same-day, but two independent sources name the date and the hill confirms the season started.

aftonalps.com banner, captured 3 December 2024, after the fact: "Opening Day Announced! The wait is over. Join us on Saturday, November 30th starting at 10:00 AM for the first turns of the 24/25 winter season." On 25 November the banner still read "Opening Day News Is Coming Soon", so the hill was shut then. News coverage agrees, reporting a first chair banner break at 10am with three trails open.

aftonalps.com banner, 2 December 2025: "Afton Opening Announcement: Afton Alps opens Thur, Dec 4th"; captured again on the 6th, after the fact: "Afton is Open. The 25/26 season is underway." On 17 November the banner offered only pre-season retail and tune shop hours.

Facebook, 29 November 2023, same day: "It is official. Afton Alps is open for the 2023/24 season", posted with photos of a "CELEBRATING 60 SEASONS - OPENING DAY 2023-2024" banner break. A comment that day reads "Nice to get some runs in today." The archive could only bracket this between 1 November ("Keep thinking snow") and 30 November ("NOW OPEN").

threeriversparks.org Hyland page, captured 27 and 29 November 2021, after the fact: "Ski hill opens Friday, Nov. 26." By 18 January the same page read "Hyland Hills is open for the season", and by 24 March "closed for the season". Facebook confirms it independently: on 26 November "Now that we are back on the hill...", and on the 27th "Thanks to everyone who came out for opening day."

fullOps.note: threeriversparks.org Hyland page, captured 27 and 29 November 2021, after the fact: "Ski hill opens Friday, Nov. 26." By 18 January the same page read "Hyland Hills is open for the season", and by 24 March "closed for the season". Facebook confirms it independently: on 26 November "Now that we are back on the hill...", and on the 27th "Thanks to everyone who came out for opening day." Hyland opens the whole hill rather than easing in, so full operations is the same day as first lift.

firstLift.note: threeriversparks.org Hyland page, 2 December 2024: "Opening day is Wednesday, Dec. 4 at 3 PM. We will see you on the slopes." The page carries a status field that read "Closed for the season" on 9, 14 and 19 November and "Open, Regular Season Hours" by 22 December, so the season did start; the announcement two days ahead is the only thing naming the day.

fullOps.note: threeriversparks.org Hyland page, 2 December 2024: "Opening day is Wednesday, Dec. 4 at 3 PM. We will see you on the slopes." The page carries a status field that read "Closed for the season" on 9, 14 and 19 November and "Open, Regular Season Hours" by 22 December, so the season did start; the announcement two days ahead is the only thing naming the day. Hyland opens the whole hill rather than easing in, so full operations is the same day as first lift.

firstLift.note: Hyland Hills Facebook, 22 November 2022, same day: "We are all dressed up in our finest fresh pressed corduroy for opening day. We will have all 3 lifts running, both terrain park rope tows (big park is closed)." The day before: "We have a lot of snow. Want to avoid waiting in line for your season pass tomorrow?" All three lifts and both park rope tows is the hill running normally, so first lift and full operations are the same day; the big park still being closed is bonus terrain, not a missing operation.

fullOps.note: Hyland Hills Facebook, 22 November 2022, same day: "We are all dressed up in our finest fresh pressed corduroy for opening day. We will have all 3 lifts running, both terrain park rope tows (big park is closed)." The day before: "We have a lot of snow. Want to avoid waiting in line for your season pass tomorrow?" All three lifts and both park rope tows is the hill running normally, so first lift and full operations are the same day; the big park still being closed is bonus terrain, not a missing operation.

firstLift.note: Hyland Hills Facebook, 28 November 2023, the hill announcing its own season: "Three more sleeps until OPENING DAY: Friday, 12/1/23 at 3pm", with a graphic repeating "be the first on the hill, 3pm, December 1st". Hyland opens the whole hill rather than easing in, so first lift and full operations are the same day. Buck Hill also opened 1 December 2023.

fullOps.note: Hyland Hills Facebook, 28 November 2023, the hill announcing its own season: "Three more sleeps until OPENING DAY: Friday, 12/1/23 at 3pm", with a graphic repeating "be the first on the hill, 3pm, December 1st". Hyland opens the whole hill rather than easing in, so first lift and full operations are the same day. Buck Hill also opened 1 December 2023.

firstLift.note: Hyland Hills Facebook, 1 December 2025: "We are opening for the season THIS WEDNESDAY (12/3) at 9:30AM. Terrain park, north runs, and north chair open at 3PM. Tuesday lessons on as scheduled." Unlike this hill's usual whole-hill opening, the terrain came in stages across the day, with the north side following at 3PM — so this is recorded as first lift only and fullOps is left open.

fullOps.note: Hyland Hills Facebook, 1 December 2025: "We are opening for the season THIS WEDNESDAY (12/3) at 9:30AM. Terrain park, north runs, and north chair open at 3PM. Tuesday lessons on as scheduled." The terrain came in across that same day, the north side following at 3PM. Hyland opens the whole hill rather than easing in, so full operations is the same day as first lift.

firstLift.note: Elm Creek Park Reserve Facebook, 16 December 2021: "1/2 Terrain Park & Bunny Hill Opening this weekend! Closed Monday - Wednesday to make more snow." The post’s graphic gives the days and hours — Saturday 18 and Sunday 19 December — which pins the weekend to Saturday rather than Friday. Corroborated by the 22 December post, tagged #reopening, announcing Bunny & North Hill "opening for the season Thursday, Dec. 23rd at 9:00 AM" and the Terrain Park at noon: the Monday-Wednesday closure fell on 20-22 December exactly as announced, and a reopening presupposes the weekend ran. Downhill was still shut on 8 December: "No downhill activities yet but we are working hard to get those hills open."

fullOps.note: Elm Creek Park Reserve Facebook, 22 December 2021, tagged #reopening #openfortheseason: "Bunny & North Hill opening for the season Thursday, Dec. 23rd at 9:00 AM. Terrain Park opening for the season Thursday, Dec. 23rd at Noon!" All three downhill areas open, on the regular schedule, after the 20-22 December snowmaking closure announced on the 16th.

firstLift.note: Elm Creek Park Reserve Facebook, 10 December 2022.

fullOps.note: Recorded as the same day as first lift. The hill was mostly running from the 10th onward, dropping terrain when the weather called for it — ordinary midwest operation rather than a staged opening, so no later date marks the start of normal operations.

firstLift.note: Elm Creek Park Reserve Facebook, 16 December 2023.

fullOps.note: Recorded as the same day as first lift. The hill opened and then shut intermittently to make snow through the rest of December, so no single later date marks the start of normal operations.

firstLift.note: Elm Creek Park Reserve Facebook, 16 December 2024, same day: "Downhill ski and snowboard opens at 3pm today."

fullOps.note: Recorded as the same day as first lift.

firstLift.note: Elm Creek Park Reserve Facebook, 19 December 2025. Opened a day ahead of the 20 December date announced on the 15th, and opened straight into full operations rather than a partial start.

fullOps.note: Elm Creek Park Reserve Facebook, 19 December 2025. Opened a day ahead of the 20 December date announced on the 15th, and opened straight into full operations rather than a partial start.

firstLift.note: Andes Tower Hills Facebook video, Saturday 20 November 2021.

Andes Tower Hills Facebook, 18 October 2022, same day: "Come out and be part of a record breaking opener!! Our earliest opener EVER!!! Open today 1pm to 6pm. Turtle Express run (bunny hill) will be only run open. $10 lift ticket." One run, five hours, discounted ticket — first lift by the hill’s own account, nowhere near full operations.

fullOps.note: Andes Tower Hills Facebook, 12 November 2022: "Count down is on reopening in 7 days! Upcoming hours: Saturday Nov.19th 10am - 4pm, Sunday Nov 20th 10-4pm, Friday Nov 25th 10am -5pm, Saturday Nov 26th 10am-5pm, Sunday Nov 27th 10am -5pm." The 18 October opener was a single afternoon on one run; the hill then shut and came back on 19 November to a posted, repeating schedule. That schedule is weekends plus the Friday of Thanksgiving week — the hill’s normal operation, which is why first lift and full operations sit a month apart this season.

firstLift.note: Andes Tower Hills Facebook, Saturday 11 November 2023.
Andes Tower Hills Facebook event, 23 November 2024: an opening weekend event.
Andes Tower Hills Facebook reel, 9 November 2025.

fullOps.note: Recorded as the same day as first lift, provisionally. Andes appears to run a weekend-only schedule, in which case opening weekend is its normal schedule and the two dates coincide by definition. Not confirmed: the earliest posted hours found so far are from 23 January 2026.

firstLift.note: Welch Village Facebook: "Welch Village is opening for the winter season on Saturday, 12/4 @ 10AM! The resort will be open 10AM-8PM on 12/4 & 12/5 to SEASON PASSHOLDERS ONLY." Counted from the pass-holder day, as at Welch in 2024-25 and 2025-26.

fullOps.note: Welch Village Facebook, 9 December 2021: "Re-opening today (12/9) 3pm-9pm. Regular season hours begin tomorrow. Open 9am-10pm." The hill ran the 4th and 5th for pass holders, shut, came back on the 9th for a six-hour evening, and went to regular hours on the 10th. Full operations dated from the hill saying its regular hours had begun.

firstLift.note: Welch Village Facebook, 25 November 2022: "Welcome to a new season! Welch Village is officially open for the 2022-23 season." No pass-holder preview mentioned.
Welch Village Facebook, 2 December 2023: "12/2 - Opening day in the Village!"

fullOps.note: Opened fully on day one — no pass-holder preview this season, unlike 2024-25 and 2025-26.

firstLift.note: Welch Village Facebook: "Welch Village Season Pass Holders ONLY on Saturday, Nov. 30th. Open to public starting on Sunday, Dec. 1st." Counted from the pass-holder day, as at Welch in 2025-26; general public access followed one day later.
Welch Village Facebook: "2025 Welch Village Season Pass Holders ONLY on Sunday, Nov. 30th from Noon - 6PM." A pass-holder preview day — lifts spinning for customers on restricted access, six hours.

fullOps.note: Welch Village Facebook: fully open 4 December 2025, four days after the 30 November pass-holder preview.

firstLift.note: Lutsen Mountains Facebook, 9 December 2021: "Open daily starting tomorrow, December 10th on 3 mountains." Three of the four, after 23in of natural snow in a week.

Lutsen Mountains Facebook, 8 December 2022: "our team is gearing up to begin daily operations TOMORROW, Friday, December 9th. We will start our day tomorrow with Ullr and Eagle Mountains and will be adding Moose Mountain Friday into Saturday." Two of the four mountains on day one, three by the Saturday, after 7in of natural snow on top of a good snowmaking week.

Lutsen Mountains Facebook: "After a week of ideal snowmaking conditions, we’re launching our 75th Anniversary season this Friday, Dec 1. Ullr Mountain will open with 5 runs and 2 lifts." One of four mountains, with gondola sightseeing and Rosie’s Café still finishing renovations — first lift, well short of full operations.
Lutsen Mountains Facebook video, 6 December 2024: "And we’re off! The 2024-25 season at Lutsen Mountains is officially underway."
Lutsen Mountains Facebook reel, 28 November 2025: "The 2025-26 season is officially underway! We’re so excited to welcome you back to the North Shore."

Giants Ridge Facebook, 26 November 2021: "It was an amazing opening day! Thank you everyone who came out! Here’s to the rest of the year!" A retrospective post, so the day is confirmed rather than announced. The Friday after Thanksgiving.

Giants Ridge Facebook, 23 November 2022: "The weather looks on point tomorrow for OPENING DAY! 38 degrees and sun. We are thankful for everyone that made tomorrow happen! Lifts Spin 9AM-4PM." Opened on Thanksgiving Day.

Giants Ridge Facebook, 2 December 2023, same day: "Opening day is finally here! Chairs Sarajevo, Helsinki, St. Moritz, and Greely’s Way all spin from 9am - 4pm." Four chairs on day one. Page link only — no permalink captured.
Giants Ridge Facebook, 30 November 2024, same day: "It’s a brisk morning for Opening day 2024-2025! Lifts spin 9am-4pm."
Giants Ridge Facebook: "Opening Day at Giants Ridge Is Almost Here. The countdown is on and we are getting ready to kick off the season at Giants Ridge next Saturday, November 29th at 9AM!"

Spirit Mountain Facebook, 26 November 2023, same day: "Opening Day is today! 10a-5p. One run top to bottom with the Express opening at 10a. There will be no beginner terrain available." One run, one lift, seven hours, no beginner terrain.

fullOps.note: Spirit Mountain Facebook: "Snow guns are back on and it’s a beautiful day to ride. Full hours start Tuesday 12/12!"

firstLift.note: Spirit Mountain Facebook, 30 November 2024, same day: "First chair vibes today on our 50th anniversary season! Stoked on the return of winter smiles and a day filled with solid laps!"

fullOps.note: Spirit Mountain Facebook: "Full-time hours start next Friday 12/13." The hill opened on 30 November and ran a partial schedule for a fortnight before going to full-time hours.

firstLift.note: Spirit Mountain Facebook: "Opening Day Announcement! Spirit Mountain opens for the 2025-26 season this Sunday, November 30 with the Spirit Express Lift spinning from 10am-5pm." One lift, seven hours.

fullOps.note: Spirit Mountain Facebook reel: "We’re opening full time starting December 12! It’s an exciting time at Spirit and it wouldn’t be possible without our incredible team that has been working around the clock." A separate, later milestone than first chair, as in 2024-25 when first chair was 30 November and full-time hours began 13 December.
